summary: Verified 3 web-only Settings/Billing bug fixes for Wayly (iter 388). All PASS. (1) Cancel-reason highlight: teal ring, bold text, check icon, aria-pressed, single-selection toggle. (2) TrialCountdownBanner copy: non-cancelled trial shows 'starts automatically' and cancelled trial shows 'Access ends when your trial ends — you won't be charged' (no 'starts automatically'). (3) PaywallModal shows at most once per session via wayly_paywall_shown=1 sessionStorage guard, 'Keep viewing my data' dismisses, subsequent trial_expired events DO NOT reopen it, and NO sonner toast appears on blocked writes. Clearing sessionStorage allows it to show again.
critical_code_review_comments: TrialCountdownBanner correctly reads user.cancel_at_period_end from /auth/me (surfaced from subscriptions.cancel_at_period_end at server.py:311).
api.js interceptor dispatches wayly:trial-expired on blocked writes without any toast call; 402 handler also dispatches event only. No duplicate toasts observed.

Settings.jsx cancel-reason button correctly applies ring-2 ring-primary-k/30, border-primary-k, bg-primary-k/10, font-semibold, shadow-sm and a Check icon when selected (aria-pressed=true). Clicking again sets cancelReason='' (toggle).
